fusions.name: Margin Slice
fusions.desc: Flicks a folded edge that deals 4 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Rustling Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses a flurry of loose leaves in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Page Turn
fusions.desc: Carries you 6 tiles forward in a quick burst of movement.

fusions.name: Dog-Eared Place
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
